Pan context and uncertainty — P4

The reconstructed pan is a visual context for design exploration. It must not be used to manufacture a replacement pan or infer a measured Solstice fit.

FeatureValue / constructionEvidence class
GM12601240 overall envelopeSee delivery/CURRENT_DIMENSIONS.md; source values are registered as PAN_PROXY_PAN_LENGTH, PAN_PROXY_PAN_WIDTH and PAN_PROXY_PAN_DEPTHPublished GM product specification; overall only
Deep and shallow sump relationshipDeep region beneath removable cover, shallower ribbed extension; tube toward deep-end flangeOEM source-photo topology; no metric calibration
Cast outline and internal wall thicknessPAN_PROXY_PAN_OUTLINE_XY and PAN_PROXY_PAN_INNER_SCALE_XYDesign assumption; not measured wall thickness
Floor and shallow shelfPAN_PROXY_PAN_FLOOR_Z, PAN_PROXY_PAN_SHELF_HEIGHT and associated size/position inputsDesign assumption; not an actual cavity section
Reference coverPAN_PROXY_COVER_OUTLINE_XY, underside, relief and thickness inputsDesign assumption; no stock/height specification
Raised cover reliefNamed outer/inner diameters, lengths and clipping box in the dimension registerTopology inspired by photo; radius/position unknown
Pickup test keep-outPAN_PROXY_PICKUP_KEEP_OUT_DIAMETER, height and centre inputsExplicit design test case; actual screen outline/clearance unknown
Tube test envelopePAN_PROXY_TUBE_DIAMETER and PAN_PROXY_TUBE_CENTERLINE_XYZExplicit design assumption; actual tube centreline and flex unknown
Insert placementPAN_PROXY_CAGE_ORIGIN_XYZ and PAN_PROXY_CAGE_ROTATION_DEGIllustration transform; not measured installed registration
Lower wall-to-floor gapDerived from the named cage-origin and floor inputs; generated summary reports the valueIllustration only; no flow/retention or operating-clearance acceptance
Vehicle mountingNo positioned tabs, bosses, bolts or mount holes in new conceptsUnresolved; omission must remain visible in fit claims

Reference: official GM pan interior, official product. The retained exact-interface follow-up identifies the pan/cover/baffle screw family but supplies no metric hidden cavity or five-seat coordinates.

Full-pan cutaway images remove part of one side wall to expose the insert. Detail views additionally crop the shallow extension. Section models remove one half through X=0; this can hide side gates and is not an instruction to remove parts. Exploded views move the insert and cover vertically for explanation, without modelling a proven removal path or mounting connection. All numeric proxy inputs and geometry construction dimensions live in src/design_parameters.py; the register and generated summary are derivative views.

All render views use the same source placement. Grey is the assumed pan/cover context; purple is the assumed pickup/tube test envelope; blue/teal is custom structure and gold is the custom moving leaf. Real source photography remains separate from rendered concept geometry.
